content.short: Lend and borrow using your NFTs on Cardano's first NFT-DeFi bridge.
content.description: FluidTokens is the first ever DeFi lending platform where borrowers can offer their most valuable NFTs as collateral to borrow cryptocurrency that can be reinvested and repaid under the requirements agreed by both parties. Lend and borrow using your NFTs on Cardano's first NFT-DeFi bridge.
